title: A Little Too Small
text:
A Little Too Small. I selected this little support pillow with the thought that my wife would appreciate it on a trip we were taking across the country. It’s billed as a lumbar support pillow but it is suitable for neck support as well. After working with it for a few weeks, we both have come to the conclusion that it’s not quite right for us, though it likely will work fine for others.

This is a duffel-shaped pillow, filled with buckwheat hulls. It’s approximately a foot long and about as big around as a 2-liter soda bottle. Unlike memory foam, this pillow holds its volume a bit and as such it provides decent support for the lumbar portion of your back or for your neck.

The problem we found with it is the very thing that others will appreciate – the size. The volume is good, but the length is a touch short and we’ve both found ourselves having to adjust it when we move in the chair or car seat. The straps do allow for securing the pillow so it doesn’t shift, but there are no buckles, so it requires additional planning.

This isn’t a bad pillow, but for us it is not ideal.
